amendment_reason: Before any model inference, original trailing space merged with answer start in source BPE tokenizer; newline forces stable token-prefix boundary. Question texts/labels/decision criteria unchanged.

evaluation.additional: KL(teacher||native) and JS divergence per forced gold-token prefix. Greedy generated 8-token sequence prefix compared against fixed expected answer token IDs; strict token prefix accuracy, not language-semantic correctness.
evaluation.confidence: Paired question-level bootstrap one-sided 95% UCB, seed 20261015, 10000 resamples (no token-level pseudo-replication).
evaluation.gate: B quality noninferiority RESEARCH-ONLY only if UCB(B-A)<=+0.05 nats/token AND paired answer-token-prefix accuracy decrease lower one-sided 95% bound >=-0.05 AND no missing/fault cases.
evaluation.primary: Paired mean per-example gold answer-token NLL B minus A; lower means B better.
evaluation.scope_limitations: 12 internally authored first-use cases are too small for production noninferiority, not independent external holdout and potentially included in original training.

goal: Evaluate real full BF16 teacher token-level NLL against frozen gold answer; native Beglin P9 A/B teacher-forced prefix NLL and greedy short generation prefix accuracy.
instructions: Answer the short question accurately. Output only the answer text with no reasoning.

items.question: What is 17 plus 26? Write the result in lowercase English words.
What is 9 times 12? Write the result in lowercase English words.
What is 48 divided by 6? Write the result as lowercase English words.
What are the two elements in water? Join the names with 'and'.
Name the gas plants absorb for photosynthesis. Use two lowercase English words.
What is the SI unit of force? Answer with the phrase 'one' and the singular unit name.
What does HTTP status code 404 usually mean? Use the usual two-word English phrase.
What are the two Boolean literal names in Python? Write them in alphabetical order with 'and'.
How many bytes are in 32 bits? Answer in lowercase English words with the unit.
What is the two-word plural of 'attorney general'?
What two-word English phrase names Japan's currency?
What is the capital of Canada? Write the city and country, separated by a comma.

primary_reference: Original P15 DeepSeek-V2-Lite BF16 source, BF16 CPU arithmetic, layer-streamed full teacher.
sensitivity_reference: Original P15 DeepSeek-V2-Lite BF16 source, FP32 CPU arithmetic, optional bounded subset only; never silently substitute.
source: Original newly authored internal questions for first use in Beglin. NOT independent external benchmark, not proven absent from pretraining.
